epistemicBoundary.purpose: Agent-era boundary falsification over competence, experience, proposal, authority, identity, norms and language action
doesNotProve: that emergent conventions are legitimate community rules by default
that open language creates a new semantic primitive
that Agent-generated games become culturally recognized games without human/community uptake

evidence.source: van Wetten, Plaat & van Duijn 2025 arXiv:2506.19095
observations: Baba Is You makes rule statements manipulable parts of game state
evaluated LLMs struggle with dynamic rule changes and use/mention distinctions even when language competence is strong
supports: RuleRepresentation != CurrentRuleTruth
RuleContent and meta-level rule manipulation must remain separate
language competence does not collapse rule-currentness reasoning
limits: benchmark competence only; no PlayExperience claim
game-specific task does not establish universal Agent behavior

observations: multi-Agent LLM self-play is coupled to Bayesian optimization over game-rule parameters
agents evaluate candidate rule configurations as a surrogate in automated balancing
supports: ProductionAgentNeed != RuntimeAgentNeed
Agent can operate over rule-search/evaluation without being a shipped world subject
RuleCandidate != authoritative deployed rule until another authority admits it
limits: automated balancing objective is not human PlayerValue proof
candidate generation/search does not establish social legitimacy

observations: benchmark connects LLM agents to 12 real video games across genres
evaluates game score, agentic strategies, visual input and fine-tuning effects
supports: synthetic GameExecution/competence is measurable across materially different GameForms
structural gameplay competence can be studied without PlayExperience evidence
limits: benchmark performance is not subjective play
MCP/interface design is implementation, not ontology

observations: populations of communicating LLM agents can converge on shared conventions from local interactions
committed minorities can trigger convention changes above observed tipping conditions
supports: Convention can emerge from repeated practice rather than central designer decree
one utterance/proposal is not identical to population-level convention currentness
Agent participation can enter social-practice dynamics without introducing a new relation primitive
limits: simulated convention convergence is not automatically legitimate human community authority

observations: LLM agents in metanorm-game variants can generate and follow normative strategies through natural-language interaction
supports: NaturalLanguage can be a representation/coordination medium for normative policy
norm content and norm authority/currentness should remain distinct
limits: natural-language norm expression is not proof of real-world legitimacy

observations: Werewolf requires strategic decision-making through free-form language interaction
the proposed method maps free-form text into a discrete latent strategic space for learning and then back to language
supports: open text action does not abolish underlying policy structure
NaturalLanguageAction can be modeled as expressive/representational realization of structured strategic distinctions
LanguageSurface != EffectAuthority
limits: latent discretization is one engineering method, not a universal law

observations: Minecraft agent aligns open-ended language instructions with observation-action histories and low-level control
high-level language goal and low-level action policy remain distinct components
supports: OpenIntentLanguage != primitive physical action
goal representation can expand while authoritative environment effects still occur through a bounded action/control interface
limits: does not show unrestricted natural language directly mutates the world

observations: framework models an unbounded and evolving space of possible human goals represented in natural language
agent performs inference over candidate goals rather than assuming one predefined goal list
supports: GoalVocabulary can be open-ended without requiring Goal as a new semantic primitive
open-intent systems need uncertainty/provenance over interpretation, not language-authoritative world mutation
limits: assistance games are not evidence that all games require open goals
synthetic user evaluation does not establish PlayExperience

protocolOnly.question: Can an Agent adjudicator become authoritative only by explicit delegated grant, and what happens when community/institution authority conflicts?
If an Agent creates rules/artifact and humans later adopt the practice, which event constitutes authorship, GameStructure admission and GameCategory legitimacy?
Can one persistent Agent remain the same social/game subject through provider/model replacement?
Can high responsiveness, co-creation and open language remain creative practice without a GameStructure?
